subject: Token endpoint returns invalid_client after key rotation
description: Partner rotated their signing key and now every token request fails with invalid_client. The new key was added to their hosted JWKS but the client assertion header still references the old kid.
resolution: The client assertion was signed with the new private key but the JWT header `kid` still pointed to the retired key. Advised partner to set `kid` to the new key's ID, keep the old key published in the JWKS until all in-flight assertions expire, and never reuse a previously used `kid`.

subject: JWKS rejected: RSA keys not accepted
description: Partner's JWKS contains RSA keys (kty=RSA). Registration in the developer portal keeps failing validation.
resolution: Singpass requires EC keys only (`kty`=`EC`, `crv` P-256/P-384/P-521). Partner regenerated an EC P-256 signing key (`use`=`sig`) and an encryption key (`use`=`enc`, `alg`=`ECDH-ES+A256KW`).

subject: Security review flagged private key exposed in JWKS
description: During a security review the partner noticed their public JWKS endpoint returns the `d` parameter for one key.
resolution: The `d` property is the private key and must never be in the JWKS. Advised immediate removal, generation of a fresh key pair with a new `kid`, and rotation. Treated as a security incident on partner side.

subject: invalid_dpop_proof on token request
description: Partner migrating to FAPI 2.0 gets invalid_dpop_proof from the token endpoint. They reuse the same DPoP proof JWT they generated for the PAR request.
resolution: A DPoP proof is bound to the HTTP method and URL (`htm`, `htu`) and must carry a fresh `jti` and `iat`. Partner now generates a new DPoP proof per request, with `htu` set to the token endpoint, using the same DPoP key pair throughout the session.

subject: invalid_grant when exchanging authorization code
description: Token exchange intermittently fails with invalid_grant. Partner's load balancer retries failed requests.
resolution: Authorization codes are single-use and short-lived. The retry re-submitted an already-used code. Also confirmed `code_verifier` matched the PKCE `code_challenge` sent in PAR. Advised disabling automatic retries on the token call.

subject: PAR rejected: redirect_uri mismatch
description: PAR call returns invalid_request. Partner sends `redirect_uri=https://app.example.gov.sg/callback/` but registered the URL without the trailing slash.
resolution: `redirect_uri` must exactly match a redirect URL registered for the app in the Singpass Developer Portal. Partner updated the registered URL in staging.

subject: Mobile app redirect with custom scheme no longer works
description: Partner's mobile app used `myapp://callback` as the redirect URL. After moving to the new FAPI 2.0 specification the portal will not accept it.
resolution: Custom scheme URLs are no longer supported. Partner must use app-claimed https URLs — Universal Links (iOS) and App Links (Android) — for redirect and app-launch URLs.

subject: Cannot decrypt ID token
description: Partner gets a JWE back from the token endpoint and their library fails with 'no matching key'.
resolution: The ID token is encrypted to the partner's `enc` key from their JWKS. Their JWKS had two `enc` keys and the library ignored the JWE header `kid`. Advised selecting the decryption key by `kid`, then verifying the inner JWS against Singpass's JWKS.

subject: Users returned with error=access_denied
description: Partner sees redirects with `error=access_denied` and wants to know if this is a Singpass outage.
resolution: Under the new API Singpass redirects back with an Authentication Error Response in more scenarios, e.g. when the user cancels. Partner should display a friendly error page and allow retry, not treat it as an outage.

subject: amr claim values changed after migration
description: Partner's authorisation logic checks `amr` for specific values and now fails after migrating.
resolution: The `amr` claim values changed with the new specifications (see Changelog > Changes in amr claim values). Partner updated their mapping and stopped relying on a fixed list.

subject: CPF data missing early Sunday morning
description: A partner reports users could not retrieve CPF contributions between 0000–0800hrs on the first Sunday of the month.
resolution: This falls within CPFB's scheduled downtime (1st Sunday of the month, 0000–0800hrs). Advised partner to show a maintenance message and let users retry later or fill in manually.

subject: NOA data unavailable Wednesday 3am
description: Users cannot fetch Notice of Assessment on Wednesday around 0300hrs.
resolution: IRAS has scheduled downtime every Wednesday 0200–0600hrs. No data is returned during the window. Partner added downtime-aware messaging.

subject: Field returned with unavailable: true
description: Partner's parser crashes because `hdbtype` comes back as `{"unavailable": true}` without a value.
resolution: The UnavailableFlag indicates no record exists at the data source. Partner must handle attributes with `unavailable: true` and treat them as empty/not applicable.

subject: How to migrate Myinfo v3 app to v5
description: Agency with an existing Myinfo v3 integration asks what changes are needed to move to v5.
resolution: Pointed to the Migration Guide for Myinfo (v3) apps: create a new app in the Singpass Developer Portal, switch to FAPI 2.0 (PAR, PKCE, DPoP, client assertion with EC keys), use the userinfo endpoint for person data, and update scope names.

subject: Legacy v4 app failing after certificate expiry
description: Partner on Myinfo v4 reports token calls failing after their signing certificate expired.
resolution: Advised updating keys per legacy JWKS guidance as a stop-gap, and to plan migration to Myinfo v5 since the v3/v4 APIs are legacy.

subject: Cannot create production app
description: Partner's staging app is complete but the 'Create Production App' option is greyed out.
resolution: Production apps require an accepted Singpass Service Agreement and completed app details (name, purpose, category, contacts). Partner's entity had not accepted the service agreement in the SDP.

subject: Requested scope not available in portal
description: Partner cannot find a Myinfo scope they need in the Allowed Scopes list.
resolution: Scopes shown depend on the app's approved purpose. Partner must justify the data needed; additional scopes require review against Myinfo key principles (data minimisation).

subject: Intermittent auth failures — slow JWKS endpoint
description: About 5% of logins fail. Partner's JWKS URL is hosted behind a cold-starting serverless function.
resolution: A hosted JWKS must be publicly reachable at all times and respond within 3 seconds; otherwise users fail to authenticate. Partner moved JWKS to static hosting with caching.

subject: PAR fails: missing code_challenge
description: Partner's older OIDC library does not send PKCE parameters.
resolution: PKCE is enforced: `code_challenge` with `code_challenge_method=S256` must be in the PAR request and the `code_verifier` in the token request. Partner upgraded the library.

subject: Eligibility for Singpass Face Verification
description: Partner asks whether they can use SFV for in-person counter verification.
resolution: Shared SFV integration guide and use-case criteria; partner to submit use case for review.

subject: Sign webhook not received
description: Partner initiated a sign request but never received the success-signing webhook.
resolution: Webhook URL must be publicly reachable over https. Partner's firewall blocked inbound calls. Also advised calling Get Signing Result as fallback.

subject: Button design approval
description: Partner wants to use a custom-coloured Singpass login button.
resolution: Must follow the Singpass Button Design Specification and brand guidelines; colour changes are not allowed.
